correctness.rationale: For every real 0<a,b<1 with a+b=1 and integer n>=3, exact unit-row projector algebra identifies the worst conditional one-step rate. A nonnegative dual vector y with a*y_i+b*y_{i+1}=1 and sum Q gives lambda_min<=1/Q for every unsymmetrized row distribution. Explicit balanced pair weights q_i/Q cancel offdiagonals and attain all diagonal lower bounds. Positive dual support and PSD zero-diagonal rigidity force uniqueness for a!=b. The a=b edge-cover construction proves the boundary. The bundled standard-library rational verifier passed 4,992 primal-dual/cover and 525 full-projector cases; finite checks supplement the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact fixed-frame design gives a geometric boundary-layer probability law with a unique full-support optimum away from equal amplitudes and a sparse minimum edge-cover optimum at equality. The sharp per-step guaranteed reduction ratio over equal sampling tends to n-1 for each n when the smaller squared amplitude vanishes, demonstrating unbounded benefit in a natural sparse local-measurement setting. The family and exact sensitivity/support classification are motivated by practical row-sampling design, not arbitrary numerical slices.
